Theorem 1 (Chapter 132)

Subject: nuclear physics | ID: 88713

Assertion

Let H be a Kahler manifold. Every compact operator T in B(H) with operator norm less than 1 satisfies the Neumann series expansion.

Proof

Step 1. The real operator \(S_{01320011}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle S_{01320011} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Step 2. Applying the torsion-free interpolation theorem to \(T_{01320012}\), we obtain the norm bound in the mixed Lebesgue scale for the appropriate exponents.

Step 3. By compactness of the Schatten spectral family \(R_{01320013}\), the image is precompact in the Hardy space topology.

Conclusion. By Steps 1-3, applying the rational convergence theorem, we conclude the proof with \(C = C_01320011 \cdot C_01320012 \cdot C_01320013\).
